verdict.rationale: Meltano projects are created in a directory you choose with `meltano init`, and plugins and pipelines are declared in the project config. The docs state you can treat the project like any software project, with version control, code review and CI/CD. Portability is backed by pip install, project-specific Docker images and self-hosting on your own servers. A community comment corroborates that it is CLI-first and self-hosted. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the git-based review/CI workflow, and explicit naming of the project config file format in the evidence.
